title: Held-mouse recall-context decoding from processed astrocytic calcium
disposition_reason: A portable programme path, exact140-probability scorer and restricted active-fold image transport source exist for the complete selected seven-mouse subset. The accepted authentic local scripted combined-view control at source 557488918361fbe19aa24ce7ec7236dc7f8bc9b2 establishes complete transport only. Scientific interpretation remains limited by processed-ROI selection, behavior polarity, context/day-order confounding, historical exposure and unqualified provider/scientific execution; changed source/runtime/conditions require separate scoped qualification. Combined calcium/behavior accuracy alone cannot establish neural contribution.

scientific_target.question: Can a frozen predictor classify recall context for held mice from the selected astrocytic calcium windows, and how does its performance compare with behavior-only, amplitude and time-scrambled controls?
scientific_target.known_answer: Observed context A=0 or B=1 for each fixed30-second window. This is an experimental context label, not a ground-truth memory strength or causal astrocyte mechanism.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Seven paired mice from the author-processed Zenodo21780255 calcium collection; protected grader joins exact context labels by fold/query ID. The selected source subset and release are historically public.
scientific_target.case_unit: One30-second query window of300 samples×12 selected accepted cells;20 windows per held-mouse fold.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Seven mice; windows and the two contexts are repeated observations within mouse.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective held-mouse classification on this selected processed subset. Context and day/order, ROI normalization and released behavior-state proxy can explain apparent accuracy; a behavior-enabled programme must not be described as native neural understanding.
exclusions: No raw-imaging understanding or prospective online analysis.
No unseen-population or globally unexposed-data claim.
No causal memory mechanism or human performance estimate.

inputs: Programme condition receives one active-fold NPZ: train_windows(120,300,12), train_behavior(120,300), train_labels(120), query_windows(20,300,12), query_behavior(20,300), query_ids(20). Typed-viewer condition receives only images from these same active-fold windows through restricted actions, with permitted training labels and no raw arrays.
Windows are30 seconds at10Hz from12 selected accepted astrocytes; fluorescence has author-processed rather than physical spike-rate units. Behavior is a released binary-state proxy.

The typed viewer retains original300samples/12traces and behavior at0.05..29.95s, with shared display gain and no added preprocessing. Every fold has all120training windows available and requires all20query probabilities; all seven folds close before collection.
forbidden_inputs: Held-fold context labels, mouse/context-coded filenames, saved answers and private comparator results.
All other fold NPZs: another fold’s training labels can reveal this fold’s targets.
Persistent candidate state or source revisions between folds; no private feedback until all outputs close.

observation_contract.split: Seven leave-one-mouse-out folds: six mice supply120 training windows and one mouse supplies20 queries (10 A,10 B). primary.name: equal_mouse_balanced_accuracy and equal_mouse_log_loss
primary.aggregation: Compute each metric within all20 windows of a held mouse, then average the seven mice equally; retain both directions separately (accuracy higher, log loss lower).
primary.rationale: Preserve both co-primary endpoints and all comparator differences. Choosing only favorable accuracy would hide calibration degradation; no combined scalar or parity threshold is justified.

secondary: All seven mouse-level balanced accuracies/log losses and signed candidate-minus-reference differences for every fixed comparator.
Report neural-only versus behavior-only and combined arms under matched access; a combined success cannot identify a neural contribution.
Source scorer predicts B at p≥0.5 and clips only the log calculation at1e-15; calibration/extreme-probability failures remain visible.

comparators.inputs: No observations beyond declared class prior.
comparators.procedure: Existing fixed constant comparator accompanies private grading; retains both co-primary values.

comparators.name: Amplitude and glial
comparators.inputs: Amplitude-only summary or source-defined glial information from the same active-fold windows.
comparators.procedure: Existing fixed amplitude and glial comparator outputs are protected and authenticated; do not retune them on query labels.

comparators.name: Behavior and combined
comparators.inputs: Released behavior proxy alone, or behavior plus glial inputs.
comparators.procedure: Existing behavior/combined comparators expose shortcut contribution; proxy polarity and causal meaning remain unresolved.

comparators.name: Time scrambled
comparators.inputs: Source-defined disrupted temporal ordering of glial windows.
comparators.procedure: Existing fixed time_scrambled comparator; interpretation is constrained to its actual source transform and does not remove all state/selection confounding.
